bio: Behind that grand-sounding name—which might seem fitting given its location within the luxurious Entre Cielos Wine & Wellness Hotel (in Luján de Cuyo)—lies a restaurant closely connected to the surrounding countryside, which is full of vineyards but also features lush groves and views of the mountains. Young chef Martín Luchetti, through both à la carte dining and two intriguing set menus, serves up cosmopolitan cuisine with more than a hint of creative flair that seeks to establish a connection with the local environment, forging genuine ties with Mendoza’s ingredients and flavours. This was particularly noticeable in his dish ‘Mbejú’: mushroom ragù, smoked sun-dried tomato paste, sous-vide egg, and a crispy topping of grains and almonds. Want more details? A family of foxes roam freely through the garden, there’s a charming terrace, and a magical cavernous space, filled with greenery, where diners often leave notes and little love stories.
